description: This file defines the Vtiger_Net_Client class, which provides an API for handling HTTP connections including GET and POST requests, setting headers, and managing responses within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_Net_Client
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP connections, requests, and responses in the vtiger CRM context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP client with a specified URL.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Sets or updates the URL for the HTTP requests and initializes the HTTP_Request object.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets custom HTTP headers for the request.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with optional parameters and timeout.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with optional parameters and timeout.

methods.name: wasError
methods.description: Checks if the last request resulted in an error.
